item.title: Free photography program for students in Caddo Parish
item.description: Caddo Parish Parks and Recreation has partnered with BD Photography to offer a "Through Their Eyes" photography program for students in grades 6-11, with classes held at the Martin Luther King Neighborhood Association on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m.

item.title: LSUS partners with Knack app to offer students on-demand tutoring
item.description: LSUS has partnered with the tutoring app Knack to provide students with 24/7 access to tutors, resulting in nearly 350 students being tutored in over 1,400 sessions since the partnership began in 2024.

item.title: NYPD: Two in custody after improvised explosive device thrown at protest
item.description: Two people have been taken into custody after a device, deemed to be an improvised explosive, was thrown during a demonstration in New York City on Saturday.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father as supreme leader
item.description: Mojtaba Khamenei, the son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named his successor, Iranian state TV announced early Monday, as the war that began with his father's killing less than two weeks ago took a dramatic turn.
